hypothesis: Remove only the two terminal factor tanh operations, at identical 89-parameter initial tensors, histories and update budgets; test fresh lexical-layout transfer and labeled retention.

design.training: Exact binding-v1 TRAIN tape (1024 outcomes) plus 128 fresh single-contact observations for kef/ruz at SVO and wom/jit at VOS. Equal per-event observed-outcome loss. Ten fresh fits; no challenge gold.
design.holdout: Four fresh words in eight withheld word-layout cells; diamond4 and bridge5 graphs with four/five active entities and four nonuniform anchor patterns. Both laws, modes, role reversals, all layout rotations. No filtering for favorable outcomes.
design.retention: New models on explicitly opened bilingual-v1, lexical-v1 and binding-v1 banks; compare archived lexical-v1 forecasts and archived original factor-v1 binding forecasts. No old model refit or recollection.
design.controls: Paired original 89-parameter factor. Final-only lexical mask/swap with shared true prefix; separate evaluator-only native-action reference. Historical GRU/additive outcomes provide context only, not a fresh-bank superiority comparator.
design.decision: Candidate must pass unchanged cell/pair/probability/control thresholds at every seed/law; observed train mean NLL<=.05, zero native/archived/paired exact regressions, and no mean fresh NLL increase versus paired original. Otherwise REVISE_SATURATION_HYPOTHESIS. All local losses and failures retained. A tie is not evidence of exclusive saturation advantage.
design.publication: Publish source/recipe/all data hashes before fit, actual ten-checkpoint bundle before collection. Offline SHA arguments are externally verified attestations.
design.failure: One fit/collection attempt, exclusive outputs, no retries, seed selection, early stopping or post-score tuning. All trained seeds collected even if training-fit diagnostic fails. Invalid/incomplete inventory stops.
design.limits: Same-team public study. Known physics, supplied identity resolution, token boundaries, two directed contact alternatives, full endpoint feedback, rank-one inductive bias and mode filtering. Not general language, G3 admission or matched-consumed-compute superiority.
